title: AI Receptionist for Tradies: What It Is and Is It Worth It?
description: What an AI receptionist for tradies does, what it can't do, and a quick test to tell if it's worth it when you miss calls on the tools or after hours.
h1_em: and Is It Worth It for a Tradie?
dek: What an AI receptionist does, how it handles calls you miss on the job, what it can't do, and how to tell if it's worth it.

faq.q: Should callers know it's an AI?
faq.a: We think yes. A short line upfront, like "you're speaking with the AI assistant for [business]", is honest and doesn't put people off when the assistant is genuinely helpful. Pretending to be a person tends to backfire when callers work it out.
The current generation sounds far more natural than old phone menus. Most callers can have a normal conversation with one.

faq.q: Can an AI receptionist book appointments?
faq.a: Yes, if it's connected to your calendar or booking system. It can also send you the details to confirm yourself.

faq.q: Is an AI receptionist better than an answering service?
faq.a: It's available around the clock and can connect directly to your systems. A human answering service can handle more complicated calls. Some businesses use both.
